question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

He said, “I will never hurt you.”

options.text: He said he should never hurt me.
He said that he would never hurt me.
He says that he will never hurt me.
He said that he will never hurt me.

solution:
The correct answer is option 2: He said that he would never hurt me.

Explanation:
When we change a direct speech sentence into indirect speech, we need to make some changes to the sentence structure and verb tense. In this case, we need to change the verb "will" to "would" to reflect the past tense of the original statement. We also need to add the conjunction "that" to introduce the indirect statement.
